notes: Profile: sell-side research portal used by 400+ analysts globally; strict US data residency for coverage data; some EU teams require EU-only buckets
Scale: plan to index ~50M documents (research notes, transcripts, filings). Expect 2-3B tokens total. Initial POC 5M -> target 50M.
Architecture ask: hybrid RAG — dense vector ANN first pass (~512-1536d vectors) + cross-encoder reranker on GPU for top-50 candidates
Latency targets: 95th pct <200ms for first-pass ANN, end-to-end (including rerank) <600ms for interactive research UX; background batch queries can be slower
Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (avg) <$0.02, but willing to trade up to $0.05 for higher recall on critical workflows
Model preferences: prefer open/quantized models for embeddings; considering 1536d embeddings (open model) vs vendor embeddings — need unit-cost comparison
Routing & fallback: want dedicated capacity for reranker (GPU) and deterministic tail latency; fallback to smaller CPU-based reranker during maintenance
Security: must integrate with AWS KMS (customer-managed keys), key rotation policy, audit logs forwarded to Splunk; SOC2 + ISO27001 required
Deployment: procurement leans to Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) or Private VPC; legal requires data residency clause and ability to run on-prem for certain datasets
Quote from Head of Research: 'We need answers fast and consistent — a few slow queries break analyst flow.'
POC metrics requested: recall@10/100, mean-latency, p95/p99, cost per 1k queries, index build time, storage footprint for vectors
Integration notes: will surface via internal search UI (React), need per-query metadata for costing and trace IDs; also want token-level cost breakdown in console
Escalations: procurement flagged T&C around retention and deletion timelines — legal loop open (RIO-1124)
Misc: drive deck contains sample pricing bands; ask: can Redwood provide a hard upper bound for p99 latency with dedicated config?
use_case_summary: Enterprise RAG for sell-side research portal: embeddings index at 50M-doc scale, ANN first-pass + GPU cross-encoder rerank, strict US data residency, KMS-managed keys, deterministic latency via Dedicated capacity; evaluate end-to-end cost per query and recall/latency tradeoffs.
